title: When The Going Gets Tough
lyrics_plain:
GET_TUFF
I've got something to tell you
I've got something to say
I'm gonna put this dream in motion
Gonna let nothing stand in my way
When the going gets tough, the tough gets going
I'm gonna get myself across the river
It's the price I'm willing to pay
I'm gonna make you stand and deliver
Giving me love in the old fashioned way
Darling,  I'll climb any mountain
Darling, I'll do anything
Ooo (Ooo)  can I touch you (can I touch you)  and do the things that lovers do
Ooo (Ooo)  gonna hold you, (gonna hold you)  I've got to get it through to you,
When the going gets tough (the tough get going)
When the going gets rough (the tough get rough)
Yeah,  yeah,   yeah, yeah
I'm gonna buy me a one way ticket
Nothing's gonna hold me back
Your love's like a slow train coming
I feel it coming down the track,
Darling, I'll climb any mountain
Darling I'll do anything
Ooo (Ooo)  can I touch you (can I touch you)  and do the things that lovers do
Ooo (Ooo)  gonna hold you, (gonna hold you)
I've got to get it through to you.
When  the going gets tough, (the tough get going)
When the going gets rough (the tough get rough)
Yea yea yea yea yea
Darling, I'll climb any mountain
Darling, I'll do anything
Darling, I'll reach for the heavens
Darling, With you loving me
Oooo (Ooooo)  can I touch you, can I touch you (can I touch you)
And do the things that lovers do
Oooo gonna hold you, (gonna hold you)
I've gotta get it through to you.
When  the going gets tough (the tough get going)
When the going gets rough (the tough get rough)
When the going gets tough (the tough get going)
When the going gets rough (going gets tough)
Yea, yea, yea, yea, yea.
